personality_one_liner: Un diseño utilitario, claro y limpio ('claro y limpio') que prioriza la legibilidad y la jerarquía de la información para la operación rápida de entregas.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm. Group related information with `sm` spacing, and use `lg` or `xl` to separate sections. Keep safe-area margins.

do's: Use on bottom tab bar to allow scrolling content to bleed behind
Use on sticky headers or sticky filter rows (like status chips)
dont's: Do not use on regular cards or list items
Do not use in dense data tables or lists

screens.name: Dashboard Propietario (Inicio)
screens.purpose: Provide a high-level summary of today's operation (revenue, active orders, couriers online) and quick actions.
screens.layout: Header with 'Hola, [Name]'. Top section: 2-column grid for key metrics (Ingresos, Repartidores). Mid section: horizontal scroll of 'Comercios'. Bottom section: list of recent active orders. Glass tab bar at bottom.

states.empty: No stats for today yet. Simple message + 'Crear Orden' CTA.

screens.name: Gestión de Órdenes
screens.purpose: Track and manage all orders filtered by their current status.
screens.layout: Sticky glass header with scrollable horizontal pill chips for status (Nuevo, Preparación, Camino, Entregado). Below, a vertical FlatList of order cards. Each card has a colored dot/badge for status, customer name, and time elapsed. Primary CTA pinned at bottom right (FAB) to create order.

states.empty: Illustration of empty clipboard. Text: 'No hay órdenes en este estado.'

screens.name: Detalle de Orden
screens.purpose: Show full order context, status timeline, and allow assigning a courier.
screens.layout: Header with Order ID. Section 1: Vertical status timeline (connecting dots). Section 2: Products list. Section 3: Customer info. Section 4: Assigned Courier with live map snippet. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom: 'Actualizar Estado' or 'Asignar Repartidor'.

states.empty: N/A - Detail always has data if reached

screens.name: Dashboard Repartidor
screens.purpose: Couriers' main view to see their current assigned delivery and easily update status while on the go.
screens.layout: Optimized for outdoor/one-handed use. Very large typography. Top: Large 'Current Delivery' card showing destination, customer, and a prominent 'Abrir Mapa' button. Bottom: sticky large full-width CTA 'Marcar como Entregado' or 'En Camino'.

states.empty: Illustration of waiting courier. Text: 'No tienes entregas asignadas. Estás en línea.'

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality with the custom Sage Green (brand) earthy palette to avoid 'generic tech app' feel while remaining clean and trustworthy.

Implement distinct role-based views. For the Owner: a denser, data-rich dashboard. For the Courier: highly legible, high-contrast, large touch targets designed for outdoor visibility and one-handed operation.
Ensure 'Nueva Orden' (Create Order) has a sticky CTA at the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView, making it easy to save.
Implement glassmorphism on the bottom tab bar and sticky order status filters, so the order list scrolls elegantly behind them.
When displaying status updates (Nuevo -> En preparación -> En camino -> Entregado), use the warning (ochre) and success (green) colors properly mapped to convey progress.
Ensure text rendered over imagery (like business covers) has a linear-gradient scrim (top-to-bottom, ending at >70% surfaceInverse opacity) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
